title: Is Organic Really Better? Healthy Food or Trendy Scam?
summary: A Kurzgesagt explainer asking whether organic food is really healthier or better for the environment. It defines what organic means and looks at pesticide use, nutrition and environmental impact, with sources.
why: Cited as a sourced overview of what organic means and how it compares on pesticides and nutrition.

quote.text: Kurzgesagt has a pretty great video[0] about organic food, and goes a little bit into what the definition of "organic" means.
